title: Digital Collections
description: A growing, searchable archive of rare and unique materials, with a focus on Idaho history and jazz.

title: Special Collections & Archives
description: Primary sources on Idaho and Pacific Northwest history — personal papers, university archives, rare books, and photographs.

title: Theses & Dissertations
description: Search over 10,000 University of Idaho theses and dissertations, with full text available for many recent titles.

title: Maps
description: Atlases, topographic maps of Idaho and the U.S., and historic aerial photographs, in the map room on the first floor.

title: VERSO
description: An archive of University of Idaho research and creative work, with web profiles for faculty, students, and staff.

title: UniVERSO
description: An AI-powered search tool for finding University of Idaho researchers and expertise using natural-language questions.

title: Gary Strong Curriculum Center
description: Curriculum materials and teaching resources for the College of Education, formerly known as the IMTC.

title: Board Game Collection
description: Board and card games available to check out for game nights, team-building, or classroom use.

title: Gov. Documents
description: All federal publications, maps, and electronic data distributed by the Government Printing Office — 1.7 million items.

title: INSIDE Idaho
description: A clearinghouse for Idaho's digital geospatial data, tools, and expertise.

title: International Jazz Collections
description: The Pacific Northwest's premier jazz archive, including Lionel Hampton's personal papers.

title: American Language and Cultures Program
description: Materials for English-language learners — grammar and vocabulary texts plus Hi-Lo literature for adults building reading skills.

title: Alfred W. Bowers Laboratory of Anthropology
description: Over 4,000 anthropology books and manuscripts, searchable in the Library catalog and housed in the Sweet Avenue lab.

title: Asian Studies Collection
description: Books, DVDs, and reference materials on Asian politics, culture, and literature in Chinese, Japanese, and English.

title: Herbarium Collection
description: Field guides, flora keys, and technical reports from the Stillinger Herbarium's botanical library.
